page_title: Always deliver your very best, always check

sources.entry: DevChecklist: a collaborative space for sharing checklists that help ensure software quality

summary.title: DevChecklists
summary.one_liner: A collaborative site of ready-made developer checklists covering software quality, feature hand-off, landing pages, web quality, and sprint meetings.
takeaways: Find shared checklists for ensuring software quality and guiding developers through crises.
Use a checklist to describe and link a feature card on Trello so others can understand it quickly.
Check landing page design points, such as keeping the page focused and detached from the homepage flow.
The Web Quality Checklist, made with the French company Opquast, is released under CC-BY-SA.
Sprint meeting points for managers are clarified as needed rather than discussed every time.
summary.summary: DevChecklists is a community site for sharing checklists aimed at developers. The page text is a short landing page with brief descriptions of several checklists: one for landing pages, one for documenting features on Trello cards, one for code quality and hand-off beyond coding, the Web Quality Checklist from Opquast (CC-BY-SA), and a sprint meeting checklist for managers. The page gives few details beyond these summaries, so the checklists themselves would need to be opened on the site.
